messages.subject: Re: How we can done Forecasting.....
parts:
Hello,

unfortunately there is no news regarding the forecast package and it remains unavailable in Renjin. I had contact with Rob Hyndman, the author of the forecast package, to inform about the state of the C and C++ code as this would have to be ported to either pure R or Java. That code base is stable and not too large but also not extensively documented. With some effort it should therefore be possible to create a package for Renjin which provides a subset of forecast's functionality that excludes the functions related to plotting. If someone is interested in creating such a package then we will be happy to provide support.

Maarten-Jan
